calibration.anchor_policy: prefer Relax, fall back to Breathing
calibration.note: The backend MUST compute an anchor feature vector for each user from a 60s low-arousal onboarding clip, store it server-side keyed by user_id, and subtract it from the current clip's features at inference time. Inference without a stored anchor is not supported.

window_eval_config.anchor_strategy: 30s-consistent: average of 30s windows of the subject's anchor clip
